_provenance.what: Per-(class,substrate) input-scale offset for the A-score gauge. Subtracted from the identity-loci mean beta before H(beta)/H_min, to align real reference tissue onto the IAMAtlas scale so healthy reads in the age-matched NORMAL band.
_provenance.why: The frozen H_min (and its H_min_beta) come from the MCMC atlas reference, which sits ~0.05 below real healthy blood on the immune identity loci. This is an atlas-side regularization gap, NOT sample compression (verified: raw methylated peak sits at ~0.95, uncompressed). noob normalization does NOT close it.
_provenance.derivation: median(healthy_reference_blood identity-loci mean beta - atlas identity-loci mean beta), from the GSM1051xxx healthy whole-blood reference batch. Disease-free, atlas-referenced (no cohort).
_provenance.validation: With immune/methyl=0.055: GSM1051xxx reference batch reads A=0.98-1.00 (NORMAL); hypomethylation walk still climbs 0.76->MARGINAL, 0.70->BREACH. Batch-to-batch residual ~0.02 remains (GSM2333xxx) and is handled by standard per-sample array normalization upstream.
_provenance.usage: Stage 4 loads this and sets cpg_gauge_engine.OFFSET before scoring. Substrate = methyl only for now; frag/wps/nucl and the non-immune classes need their own reference-derived offsets before those columns are scored live.

pending.note: Non-immune classes (tissue) and non-methyl substrates await their own disease-free reference offsets. Until set, those (class,substrate) pairs default to 0.0 and will read low until their offset is frozen.
